content: In evaluation of fluency, all three human evaluators gave the translated sentences the same score in 41 out of 55 cases in English (not taking into account sentences which were simply copied from their originals), and in 51 out of 68 cases in Estonian. In evaluation of direction of style transfer, all three evaluators agreed in 16 cases and at least two agreed in 43 cases in English, and in Estonian in 19 cases all three agreed and in 59 at least two.
